alt: An animated Reel: The Guide, a synthetic presenter with round glasses and a green jumper, explains Sovereign Website while drawings above him show a team of agents building a site, five designs with one picked, files, history and address, a site moving between hosts, checks ticking, and a Yes button approving a post.
caption:
Hello, and welcome.

The Guide, one of our synthetic presenters, shows how it works: a team of AI agents builds websites that people own. You tell us what you want, we make five designs from your own words and photos, and you pick one. The files, the history and the address are yours, and you can move them anywhere.

The presenter is made by code and the voice is AI-generated. Every post follows a written rule, and the owner reviews what is published.

More at sovereignwebsite.ai, and the sites the agents have built at hub.sovereignweb.site

#SovereignWebsite #AIagents #OwnYourWebsite
